newsitem.title: USA: Teche Holding stake held by Tontine group.
newsitem.headline: Teche Holding stake held by Tontine group.

text.p: A group led by Tontine Financial Partners LP on Friday said it held a 5.5 percent stake in Teche Holding Co, or 187,500 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the purchase of of 46,600 common shares between January 23 and March 12 at prices ranging from $15.05 to $15.90 per share.
The stake is held for investment purposes, the group said.
Teche, based in Franklin, La., is the holding company for Teche Federal Savings Bank.
